productSpecificity.evidence: A retains its plain booking-sheet hierarchy, overlap mark, direct task title and compact state summaries across press/A/390-entry.png, press/A/320-edit.png, press/A/320-review.png and press/A/320-success.png. A uses a named search form and native habitat select; B uses a fieldset and aria-pressed filter buttons, plus both title and Read record buttons. productSpecificity.dimension: Supplied facts/artifacts that actually shaped composition
productSpecificity.evidence: listen/B/1440-entry.png names reeds/channels/quiet water and gives record ID/habitat stamps, dates and monospaced durations distinct roles. listen/B/1440-detail.png's EL-03 sketch has two isolated disturbances beside the quiet note and transcript's two splashes; listen/B/index.html defines different illustrative paths per record. The caption and annotation style continue around the record-specific schematic. A has a consistent calm sans-serif ledger direction but less differentiation of notebook annotations.
productSpecificity.tradeoff: B's small monospaced labels and large ribbon consume narrow space; A's simpler typographic system is easier to scan at 390 and uses fewer competing treatments.

productSpecificity.dimension: Structure responding to relationships rather than an interchangeable shell
productSpecificity.evidence: B's detail groups the listening note with a record-specific illustrative sketch, then transcript, while metadata and audio availability form an adjacent fact column at 1440 (listen/B/1440-detail.png). The two isolated marks visibly relate to the quiet EL-03 observation and two-splash excerpt. productSpecificity.dimension: Recognizable decisions preserved across widths/states without task harm
productSpecificity.evidence: Both retain notebook rows, ID/habitat distinction, duration, long title and restrained green/paper palette in the 320 return and detail images. B keeps monospaced annotations and stamps; A keeps its ledger hierarchy and water mark. Both preserve search/filter context and wrap the long title without horizontal overflow in recorded checks.
productSpecificity.tradeoff: B has a notably crowded 390 disclaimer and later entry controls; A's identity is less visually assertive but more compact. Neither gains this dimension solely through novelty, and the observed styling differences do not justify overriding the respective task tradeoffs.

findings.label: B

limitations: Independent procedural blinding: read only reviewer instructions, packet index, tasks, listed screenshots, source and checks; did not read a key, manifest, creator notes, teaching examples or another review.
Inspected exactly the listed 30 natural viewport images. Did not inspect optional full-page images or infer post-action visibility from them.
No independent browser rerun, network, installation or human testing. Source inspection clarifies ordering/retention but is not a rendered test.

Recorded browser/axe checks have no failures; incomplete contrast items remain in packet evidence. Full accessibility conformance, human comprehension/usability, uniqueness and novelty are unassessed.
Only EL-03 detail was visually inspected; all four records and per-record sketch definitions were read in source. Other detail appearances are not visually certified.
Initial start timestamp was not sampled; startedAt and exact elapsed duration are null. Last work completion timestamp is sampled in UTC.
No aggregate winner or score is assigned; task quality and product specificity are judged independently.
